prompt: Update the CLAUDE.md of a project I already edited manually (added a custom section at the top), without clobbering my additions

assertions.text: Preserves all content above the `<!-- wiki-managed: start -->` marker
Preserves all content below the `<!-- wiki-managed: end -->` marker
Regenerates only the managed section from the current wiki state
Is idempotent on re-run when the wiki state has not changed
